**RMBGH Mailing System Policy**

**Purpose & Scope**
This policy outlines the rules for using the RMBGH corporate mailing system. It applies to all employees, contractors, and third parties utilizing RMBGH email domains.

**Acceptable Use**
***Business Use:*** Use the email platform primarily for official company operations.
***Professional Tone:*** Maintain a polite, ethical, and professional communication style.
***Standard Signatures:*** Use approved company templates for all external signatures.

**Prohibited Activities**
***Personal Gain:*** Do not use work email for personal business or commercial sales.
***Inappropriate Content:*** Do not send defamatory, offensive, or harassing materials.
***Unsafe Content:*** Do not distribute spam, chain letters, or unauthorized mass emails.

**Security & Privacy**
***Data Protection:*** Encrypt messages containing confidential, financial, or sensitive company data.
***Credential Safety:*** Never share account passwords or access tokens with anyone.
***System Monitoring:*** RMBGH reserves the right to audit and monitor all corporate emails.
***Zero Privacy:*** Users have no expectation of privacy regarding network email traffic.

**Enforcement**
Violations will result in disciplinary review. Penalties include loss of system access, termination, or legal action.
